experiment: Synthetic sensor self-noise and shared neural event splauts
conclusion: Conservative self/shared energy transfer plus a sparse spatial prior recovers both sources under moderate independent sensor noise, with an extra location in one case. Noise-only controls remain self. Stronger noise, waveform interference and regularization tradeoffs remain failures.

protocol.checkpoint_selection: Minimum fixed final objective over every iterate, including the initial all-self model. Ground truth never selects a checkpoint.

equations.sparsity: sum_k a_k / (tau + sum_j exp(-||x_k-x_j||^2/(2*r^2))*a_j); r=15 m
equations.support: min(effective rendered station count, soft count of positive temporally centered template correlations)
equations.gate: a_k = rendered mean energy in fixed station-balanced observation units

tests: 51 unit tests passed, including conservative self residuals, overprediction rejection, stationary-spectrum and one-sensor counterexamples, invariance to splitting one location, and mixture-only source recovery with local bursts.
interpretation: All-self initialization has perfect total reconstruction and zero shared energy; reconstruction by itself does not measure separation.
Primary cases add independently simulated source/noise powers. Waveform-addition cases include cross terms and are separate stress tests.
True source count, source fields, sensor noise and four unseen station recordings are excluded from fitting and checkpoint selection.
A single fixed final joint objective selects all checkpoints, including all-self, during continuation.
Pilot seed 7 informed development; 19 and 31 are additional noise/position realizations of the same source family.
At moderate noise, all six sources localize within 4.8 m, with one additional site. Noise-only controls infer exactly zero shared energy.
The sparse spatial penalty favors fewer locations, but its seed-7 held-out prediction is worse than both the no-sparsity and no-coherence ablations.
At higher noise only two of six sources fall within 10 m. Reasonable aggregate source-power reconstruction is not proof of correct locations.
next_experiments: Use held-out sensor validation or station folds to test source births and select regularization without clean labels.
Test more independent source families, geometries, sensor gain patterns and noise distributions.
Address coherent waveform cross terms and stationary sources that temporal power correlation cannot distinguish from self-noise.
